name: Lake Tahoe
tagline: Alpine lake for summer beaches and winter skiing
summary: Lake Tahoe is a huge, startlingly clear alpine lake on the California–Nevada border. In summer paddle and swim from sandy coves, hike to Emerald Bay and Vikingsholm, cycle the east shore trail and ride the Heavenly gondola; in winter ski Palisades, Heavenly and Northstar.
seasonNote: Ski season December to April; summer for the lake; autumn is quiet and golden.
arrival: About 1 hour from Reno airport, or 3.5 hours from San Francisco.
gettingAround: A car is needed; chains in winter.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere. Tip 18 to 20 percent at restaurants.
baseArea: South Lake Tahoe or Tahoe City
